files.name: motion-prompt-111.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Chromatic aberration" (色収差), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #111

What it is: Red and blue-violet colour fringes along high-contrast edges
What the sample shows: The street scene is split into red, green and blue and the three are laid back together at slightly different sizes, so red and cyan fringes appear on the edges of the person, buildings and lamps, larger towards the sides.
Spec:
- Scene 2: a street corner; buildings, trees and street lamps (x 114, 292, 494) behind a road at y 132–162; the person stands front left (feet at x 176, y 200, 124 px tall). 
- Split: the image is multiplied by red #FF0000, green #00FF00 and blue #0000FF into three copies and added back together over black
- Scale about the centre: red 1 + 2s, green 1 + s, blue 1, with s = 0 → 0.02
- Offset: red and blue end up about 11 px apart at the left and right edges, 0 at the centre
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: To add an imperfect old-lens, VHS or glitch feel.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/111.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
